data.name: Rok
data.gender_notes: Rok is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ruk’ which means rock. This name represents strength, courage, and vitality. It is also associated with the element of fire. The name Rok carries the meaning “Rock” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Rok usually hope their child will grow to embody rock and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the inner strength and courage to overcome challenges in life. It is a reminder to remain steadfast and grounded, like a rock, during difficult times.
data.etymology: Rok belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rock.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rok total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
